effective_latest_coverage.note: Latest per-file results combine the full run with the final affected rerun, including two additional Agent cases. This is not a second complete-suite pass.

corrections_and_observations.detail: Duplicate Binding pins correctly failed Protocol validation; corrected the new assertion from INVALID_COMMAND to PROTOCOL_VALIDATION_FAILED.

Native EndAssignment correctly refused ending the active priority arbiter assignment. The new owner-revocation fixture now grants a replacement owner and updates project settings before ending the original assignment.
Two assertions for a no-op migration still expected the former current format 9; updated them to current format 10.

The existing Bun-module ACL test did not match recovered/resources_disposed after its fixed 200 ms cleanup wait. Its original failure remains in the full report; the final 12-test IPC file passed. Runtime production and test code were not changed for this observation. Timing is a suspected cause, not a proven diagnosis or bug fix.

SQLite JSON object text equality depends on key order. The new Agent relationship guard compares digest/reference scalar fields and ordered Skill pin arrays; the final rerun includes reordered-key acceptance and altered-pin refusal.

constructed_fixture_boundary.controlled_allow: Directly inserted synthetic ProviderEvidence, ProviderEvaluation and task_execution Binding facts; current production assessment/approval commands cannot create these formal approvals.
constructed_fixture_boundary.trusted_host: In-process fake admission and result-proof verifier, bound to Native records. No actual model or physical Runtime qualification is exercised.
constructed_fixture_boundary.billing: Native same-currency reservation/settlement only; no Coding Plan credit qualification, account ledger or actual invoice proof.
constructed_fixture_boundary.production_default: LocalRunVerifier has no agent port, and formal Task Binding remains refused. Adding record schemas does not enable Agent execution.
